policy: Existing DRK title, artist and stats profiles transferred without fitting onto the seven independently normalized land/gold scans. Native component captures and combined output agree. Original wording, frame/color settings and frozen scan poses remain unchanged. These small, repeatedly inspected cohorts are development references, not complete-set certification.

metrics.policy: Grayscale, both edge polarities, local contrast and filled-area Dice with stroke-width error. Fixed broad/tight/prefix crops; source/scan poses unchanged. Metric weights match existing title and artist fits; stats uses artist diagnostic weights. This is transfer evidence, not a new fit or whole-card accuracy.

fullScores.policy: Same original inputs, exact native captures, frozen scan-only poses and unchanged region policy. Standard application aggregation and separately labeled reviewed-credit aggregation. No hosted score upload. Similarity indices are not correctness percentages.
